messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: P1 - inference-prod-east - Elevated 5xx (triggered 1792345012). Notifying on-call: Sofia Kim.

Sofia Kim: Ack. I'm looking. Dash shows 503/522 bursts starting ~20:10 UTC. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/alerts/1792-prod-east

Noah Martinez: scope check: errors concentrated on text-chat route with long-tail latencies, ~12% error rate on prod-east across three AZs.

Brandon Li: tailing runtime logs now. Found repeated failures with two error classes: `kernel/pack:pivot` and `runtime/op:panic` around the same timeframe. Snippet:
```
[2026-06-15T20:10:05Z] node-5 POST /v1/chat 200 95ms
[2026-06-15T20:10:11Z] node-3 POST /v1/chat 503 kernel/pack:pivot mismatch
[2026-06-15T20:10:13Z] node-4 POST /v1/chat 522 runtime/op:panic: out of range
[2026-06-15T20:10:15Z] node-2 POST /v1/chat 503 kernel/pack:pivot mismatch
```

Eve Park: note that a config push for quant-packer (`commit b3c9e2`) went live at 20:09 UTC to prod-east only. Could be correlated.

Samir Das: customer impact: 5 paid customers affected intermittently; one high-throughput partner saw session failures. CRM ticket IDs: C-2091, C-2094. Notifying account teams now.

Sofia Kim: immediate mitigation options: A) route fallback to stable non-quant model B) scale up safe pool C) toggling packer to previous settings. I propose A+B asap to reduce customer impact.

Brandon Li: I can flip route to stable variant and scale safe pool. Running scoped canary (15% -> 50%) on prod-east.

deploy-bot: Initiating route switch canary for `redwood/chat-large-stable` in prod-east at 1792345060. Job id: rc-9001.

~3m later~

deploy-bot: Canary 15% applied -> success. Error rate on canary drops to ~1%. Non-canary remains ~11%.

Noah Martinez: testing reproduce locally: sending 3 requests with seq=7000, temp=0.1 -> runtime/op:panic repro on nodes with `b3c9e2`. Nodes rolled back to previous packer show no panic.

Eve Park: hypothesis list (in-thread):
- H1 (owner: Brandon) - `b3c9e2` packer change causes qkv packing stride mismatch for long sequences -> index/pivot errors.
- H2 (owner: Noah) - routing mixed quant/non-quant kernels for same session due to sticky routing bug causing inconsistent memory layouts.
- H3 (owner: Samir) - traffic pattern changed due to a customer scheduled job causing increased concurrent long-sequence requests and exposing race in packer initialization.

Brandon Li: I'm running a scoped rollback of `b3c9e2` on a subset of quant nodes and will run the regression harness. Steps: revert packer config -> restart runtime -> send long-seq repro.

Sofia Kim: FYI I'll need to hand off on-call in ~20m. Brandon, can you take primary after you complete the rollback start?

Brandon Li: yes, I'll be primary. I'll also coordinate with deploy-bot for staged rollback.

~10m later~

deploy-bot: Rollback canary 10% applied -> nodes on previous packer report no panics; canary error rate 0.6%.

Noah Martinez: confirmed: repro fails on nodes with `b3c9e2`, passes on rolled-back nodes. H1 gaining evidence.

Samir Das: customer comms: issued interim status to impacted accounts; offering compensatory credits pending final RCA. Keeping tickets open.

Brandon Li: proceeding to full rollback across quant pool with health checks. Command: `redwoodctl config rollback --component packer --from b3c9e2 --to f1a7c00 --stages 10,50,100 --health error-rate<1%`.

deploy-bot: Rollout rc-9002 started. Stage 10% -> success (no errors). Stage 50% -> success.

~8m later~

deploy-bot: Rollout rc-9002 completed at 1792345286. Error rate in prod-east back to baseline (~0.3%).

Sofia Kim: handoff: Brandon is primary now. Leaving notes on ongoing post-incident tasks; I'll join the RCA tomorrow morning.

Brandon Li: assigning owners for follow-ups: Brandon (mitigation/playbook update), Noah (repro + CI harness), Eve (artifact review + packing math fix), Samir (customer follow-through).

Brandon Li: action items in-thread:
- Brandon: update runbook to include packer rollback steps and automate health-check gates (due 24h)
- Noah: add regression tests for seq lengths 4096, 8192, 16384 into CI and validate packer behavior (due EOD)
- Eve: prepare and open patch to revert/adjust packer stride and add unit tests (PR by EOD)
- Samir: finalize customer impact summary and coordinate credits (due 2h)

Noah Martinez: timeline draft (will paste full timeline into /tmp/incident/1792345012): 20:09 config push b3c9e2 -> 20:10 first 503s -> 20:11 paging -> 20:13 canary rollback start -> 20:21 full rollback complete.

Sofia Kim: excellent. I'll mark this P1 as resolved once we confirm all postmortem owners accept tasks.

deploy-bot: Incident resolved: P1 inference-prod-east resolved at 1792345298.

Samir Das: leaving notes: saved logs & core dumps to /tmp/incident/1792345012, uploaded packer artifacts and diffs to the MR. Will keep support thread open until customers confirm stability.

Brandon Li: closing paging. We'll convert this to a formal postmortem doc tomorrow. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
